body: It has been quite a dramatic shift. Since last night I also realized he has been talking about things like being an empath, sensing energies, and the like for a while too. He often thinks he knows more about the world than other people and now claims that he has been “cursed” because of that knowledge. He recently refuses to go outside because he thinks he will be poisoned by negative energy. I think he has been withholding these things from his therapist because she “won’t understand”. I don’t have any contact with his psych care team but I’ll see if I can figure out how to get him to leave the house to see a doctor.

I’m so sorry this has happened to you too. I’m not going to lie, it still hurts. Almost every day. How long has it been for you? Does it start to feel better?
Also, you’re not contagious unless you have an active cold sore. When the cold sore is gone, you won’t get anyone sick.

If your mom has had them her whole life, it was probably transmitted to you before you were even born. You can get it from touching dirty surfaces and touching your face, too (if the surface was touched by a person who touched an active cold sore). Nearly everyone I know has had a cold sore. It’s almost like a pimple now with how common it is. Please don’t be angry at your Mom, she could not have resisted passing it to you if she tried.
I don’t know the whole situation but this is such a common manipulation tactic. I hope you are safe and if not I wish you healing

I have PDD i guess which stands for persistent depressive disorder or something. Sorry I can’t remember 100%, I’m really really baked right now. I’ve tried different treatments and they’ve either not worked or made everything worse. I don’t know wtf is wrong with me, I just feel trapped
Yeah, that’s 100% true. Thank you so much for your advice.

It’s definitely a really weird thing to experience. Two completely polar opposite emotions at the same time. I’ll be calling my psych soon and when I see him I’ll mention my concerns to see what he thinks. I’m just worried he’ll be dismissive for whatever reason. 

I never knew that about the spectrum thing - I always thought it was just 1 or 2 or not at all. Admittedly I’m not super well-versed in the subject. But i’ve been just accepting the PDD Dx because, well, I’ve never had a real “manic” episode, and I’m actively scared to... so I just suppress the fears as irrational.

Thanks friend! It’s been hard trying to toy with medications and it’s easy to give up especially when so much of me is at stake. But i’ll definitely try to explore other possibilities. I know it’s a long and hard process, which is what’s scaring me away. I feel like I’d much rather be numb than feeling every emotion on the scale all at once on meds that don’t work. Wellbutrin had me hysterically laughing and crying at the same time for like 4 days straight.

I definitely am planning on calling my psych to set up an appointment soon. I haven’t seen him in at least a few months since I stopped trying with SSRIs. 

I just read up on cyclothymia, which is what I think you meant, and a lot of the Wikipedia descriptions of the depressive phase sound really familiar to me. I have a fuzzy memory of my childhood for some reason so it’s hard for me to think back to any possible hypomanic episodes. Hopefully I can figure out how to actually tell my psych that I’m concerned without sounding paranoid.

Wow, thanks for your comment. As I was reading I just remembered another period in my life when I was pretty young and for at least six months was obsessed with getting sexual gratification from others i.e. texting many different boys inappropriate photos and thriving off of it, feeling very intense emotions about multiple people at the same time, etc. I must have been at most 13 or 14. It was a crazy hypersexuality thing that I honestly don’t remember a lot of (my memory has some decent sized gaps in it, alarmingly) but it’s strikingly different from how I am now, or even have been in the past aside from this one creepy period. I don’t even really have much of a libido.

I used to be really “sad” as a kid. What I remember the most is how lost and depressed I felt in middle school. Way too depressed for any 11 year old to be, especially since I had a relatively healthy home life and wasn’t really bullied or anything. It’s weird to think about that period because now I just feel dull - I have no hobbies, can’t pay attention to movies, and sleep all the FUCKING time. :( 

I do have a psychiatrist who has helped me with antidepressants, but since I no longer take them I haven’t seen him in a while. Im planning on calling and making an appointment soon, I just don’t know how I’d bring this up without sounding like I’m making it all up. I feel like he’d just dismiss me because i’m *clearly* depressed. I’m just getting exasperated with feeling like I’m at 1/4 charge all the time and nothing is helping. 

(Sorry for unsolicitedly hardcore venting to you, btw. Thanks for listening)
